description: Locate natural-language visual targets in the latest RGB observation. Set include_distance=false for visibility or location only. Set it true only when a precise metric threshold or completion claim requires robust camera-to-visible-surface depth. Returned candidates require semantic confirmation from the annotated tool evidence.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise natural-language description of the visible target.

include_distance.description: Whether each candidate also needs robust metric depth. Keep false for detection-only questions.
